name: Thomas Barnes
title: Aspiring Actuary | Mathematics, Finance & Data Analysis
introduction: I'm Thomas Barnes, a First Class Honours Mathematics graduate from the University of Leeds and an aspiring actuary. I'm particularly interested in the application of mathematical and statistical techniques to financial modelling, risk assessment and the management of uncertainty. My academic background has provided me with a strong analytical foundation, which I'm keen to apply and further develop as I pursue a career in the actuarial profession.
about: This portfolio brings together a selection of my academic and independent work, spanning actuarial and financial modelling, statistical analysis, machine learning and programming. Each project provides an overview of the problem, the methodology and the key findings, alongside the supporting analysis and technical work. The aim is to demonstrate how I've applied my mathematical knowledge and technical skills to a range of problems, while providing an insight into my approach to analysis and problem-solving.
contactIntro: If you'd like to discuss my work or get in touch about professional opportunities, I'd be pleased to hear from you.
biography: My interest in the actuarial profession developed throughout my Mathematics degree, particularly as I explored how mathematical and statistical models can be used to assess risk and uncertainty. I'm especially interested in how actuaries apply these techniques to areas such as insurance pricing, reserving and capital modelling, where understanding future financial obligations and the assumptions behind them is essential. What appeals to me about the profession is the combination of technical analysis and practical decision-making. Alongside my academic background, I've gained valuable professional experience in customer-facing roles, including as a Personal Banker at NatWest. These roles have helped me develop my communication skills, attention to detail and understanding of working within a financial services environment. I'm keen to combine these experiences with my technical abilities as I work towards becoming a qualified actuary.
experience: I graduated from the University of Leeds with First Class Honours in Mathematics. My degree provided a strong foundation in actuarial and financial mathematics, probability, statistics and optimisation, with relevant modules including Actuarial Mathematics I & II, Stochastic Calculus for Finance, Time Series Analysis and Combinatorial Optimisation. I also graduated eligible for exemptions from the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries' CM1 and CM2 examinations, subject to redemption. Throughout my studies, I developed practical experience using Excel, Python and R for mathematical modelling, statistical analysis, forecasting and optimisation, achieving first-class grades across my Excel-based coursework.
